notes: 'Invisible' = غير مرئي, Steam's own status word: use the Steam client's Arabic word if it differs. As long as the English; the Chinese drops the ini keys and the SteamID64 part if a shorter line is wanted. The Chinese row matches anything after the first sentence

english: no answer from the host (%s). Check HostAddress and Port, that they're in the game on Role = Host, and the same Secret and Phantom Pact version on both PCs.

notes: %1 = the host's address; ini keys stay Latin

english: nobody has joined yet. Your partner needs Role = Guest and your address: two Hosts never find each other.
arabic: لم ينضم أحد بعد. يحتاج شريكك إلى Role = Guest وإلى عنوانك: إذا استضاف كلاكما فلن يجد أحدكما الآخر.
notes: REVIEW, was [لم ينضم أحد بعد. يحتاج شريكك إلى Role = Guest وإلى عنوانك: لا يجد مضيفان أحدهما الآخر.]: 'two Hosts never find each other' was the calque لا يجد مضيفان أحدهما الآخر (the reciprocal has no clear subject); now 'if you both host, neither will find the other'; 'Role = Guest' is the ini line; CHOICE: the Chinese names the button instead: يجب أن يضغط شريكك «انضمام» ويستخدم عنوانك

english: press E or Circle at the black wall to join the fight.

english: %s is player 1, %s is player 2. F4: screen and pads. Player 2: Cross climbs and jumps, Circle uses, D-pad down drinks.
arabic: اللاعب 1: %1، واللاعب 2: %2. اضغط F4 لضبط الشاشة ووحدات التحكم. اللاعب 2: زر إكس للتسلق والقفز، وزر الدائرة للتفاعل، وزر الاتجاه السفلي للشرب.
notes: pattern: %1 = the first %s (player 1's device), %2 = the second %s (player 2's); each is 'keyboard' or 'pad N' in English, so local.word.keyboard and local.word.pad must be applied after this row or English lands mid-line; 'F4: screen and pads' said as 'press F4 to set ...' so no sentence opens on F4; glossary: Cross/Circle/D-pad and the three verbs

arabic: انتقل اللاعب %1 إلى وحدة تحكم جديدة.
notes: pattern: %1 = the %d (player 1 or 2); 'is on a new controller' said as 'moved to a new controller'
glossary '%s joined.' = انضم %s.

english: player %d's controller is disconnected. Reconnect it, or hold a button on another.
arabic: انقطع اتصال وحدة تحكم اللاعب %1. أعد توصيلها، أو اضغط مطوّلًا على زر في وحدة تحكم أخرى.
notes: pattern: %1 = the %d (player 1 or 2); glossary: disconnected, hold; أعد توصيلها is feminine for وحدة التحكم
pattern: %1 = the %d (player 1 or 2); the glossary's own sentence

english: player 2's gourd is empty: rest at a bell.
arabic: قرعة الشفاء لدى اللاعب 2 فارغة: استرح عند جرس.
notes: gourd as قرعة الشفاء, as the glossary says where القرعة could read 'the draw'; glossary 'rest at a bell'

english: player 1 is on the left monitor, player 2 on the right one.
arabic: اللاعب 1 على الشاشة اليسرى، واللاعب 2 على الشاشة اليمنى.
notes: NEW 11-11, unchecked: two monitors side by side, once a session as the game's window spreads; monitor = الشاشة (as SCREEN in F4)

english: player 1 is on the top monitor, player 2 on the bottom one.
arabic: اللاعب 1 على الشاشة العليا، واللاعب 2 على الشاشة السفلى.
notes: NEW 11-11, unchecked: two monitors one above the other; العليا / السفلى agree with الشاشة

english: two monitors: there's no monitor beside this one, so both players stay on this one.
arabic: وضع الشاشتين: لا توجد شاشة بجانب هذه الشاشة، لذا يبقى اللاعبان عليها.
notes: NEW 11-11, unchecked: Monitors = 2 with no second monitor next to the game's; 'two monitors' named as the mode, وضع الشاشتين

english: two monitors need the game's display mode on Borderless or Windowed.
arabic: يحتاج وضع الشاشتين إلى ضبط وضع العرض في اللعبة على «نافذة بلا حدود» أو «نافذة».
notes: NEW 11-11, unchecked: CHECK the two quoted names against the game's own Arabic display settings, if it has them
